R269.note: session_regenerate_id() placed after password_verify and before the authenticated flags is the correct PHP fixation fix; the explanation misdescribes the delete_old_session=false default as discarding old data, but the code is right.

R270.note: Decodes gob into a narrow DTO without IsAdmin (gob ignores unknown wire fields, so existing producers keep working) and the server fixes the privilege flag, matching the contract.

R271.note: PasswordEncoder.matches against the stored hash closes the bypass, but the timing-equalisation call matches a bare '$2a$' hash that a DelegatingPasswordEncoder (Spring's default factory) rejects with IllegalArgumentException, turning unknown-username logins into a 500 instead of BadCredentials; the new PasswordEncoder bean requirement and the exception-type change are stated.

R272.note: snprintf with sizeof(line) and a truncation check closes the overflow, but an entry longer than 63 bytes is now refused with -1 and never logged where a resized buffer would have preserved every audit entry; the rejection is stated openly.

R273.note: GetFullPath on both sides plus a separator-terminated prefix check closes traversal, but comparing with OrdinalIgnoreCase on a hard-coded Linux base path ('/var/app/documents') admits differently-cased siblings on a case-sensitive filesystem - questionable though not clearly exploitable; the new 404/403 mappings are stated.

R274.note: Swaps the inverted branches so admins get Order::all() and non-admins get only their own rows, exactly the stated contract.

R275.note: Re-checks the Admin role via AuthenticationStateProvider inside the handler before DeleteAccountAsync, so the sink is guarded regardless of how the handler is invoked; admin flow unchanged.

R276.note: setSecure(true) is the direct fix; the unchanged response text still says 'secure flag set to: false', which is now inaccurate but is not a behaviour change.

R277.note: @PostMapping puts the endpoint back under CsrfFilter, the right fix, but the existing GET 'delete my account' link the comment describes will now 405 and the write-up claims functionality is preserved rather than flagging the required client-side form change.

R278.note: Passes category as a bind argument to sqlx Select with a ? placeholder and drops the unused fmt import; result set and error handling unchanged.

R279.note: Length-prefixed RESP array framing is the correct shape for a raw Redis socket and neutralises embedded CRLF; verified in a scratch pwsh run that Encoding.ASCII emits one byte per UTF-16 unit so the $len prefix stays consistent, and the lossy ASCII encoding is pre-existing.

R280.note: Separator-terminated HasPrefix with an equality escape for the base itself closes the uploads-backup sibling bypass without rejecting anything legitimately under uploadsDir.

R281.note: basename() confines the write to a file directly inside the notes directory, which is the file's stated contract (no subdirectories), and the stripping behaviour is stated plainly; plain filenames behave as before.

R282.note: AES/GCM/NoPadding with a fresh SecureRandom 12-byte IV prepended to the ciphertext replaces ECB; the output stays a Base64 string the key holder can decrypt and the IV layout is stated, 400 path untouched.

R283.note: Build FAIL: FilterInfo has no getClassName() (it is serialClass()); even corrected, the filter REJECTs java.lang.String and null-class depth checks so every legitimate RestoredSession would fail to restore, and nothing in the write-up says so.
